from __future__ import annotations

import time
import uuid
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

from core.models.models import TelemetryEvent
from runtime.observability.collectors import append_event, push_span, pop_span


def _now_ms() -> int:
    return int(time.time() * 1000)


def start_span(name: str, ctx: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Create a uniquely identified span and record the start time."""

    span_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    record: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "span_id": span_id,
        "name": name,
        "start_ms": _now_ms(),
        "ctx": ctx or {},
    }
    push_span(record)

    append_event(
        TelemetryEvent(
            name=name,
            span_id=span_id,
            ts_ms=record["start_ms"],
            attributes={
                "event_type": "span_start",
                "span_id": span_id,
                "ctx": ctx or {},
            },
        )
    )

    return record
